name: XSum: Extreme Summarization Dataset
description: XSum (Extreme Summarization) is an abstractive document summarization benchmark curated by the University of Edinburgh NLP Group (Narayan et al., EMNLP 2018). The dataset consists of 226,711 BBC news articles spanning 2010 to 2017 paired with their professional one-sentence summary (the introductory bold sentence). The task requires answering 'What is the article about?' in a single concise sentence. Formally partitioned into 204,045 training (90%), 11,332 validation (5%), and 11,334 test (5%) article-summary pairs.
